name: TrustLayer verification dev set
provenance: Authored by the implementing agent alongside the engines (so not blind); synthetic corpora; not human reviewed. Companies and pages are fictional unless a case needs a real domain pattern. Corpus text is fixture content, not quotes from the real sites.

cases.notes: Two independent non-authoritative domains meet the threshold.

request.response_text: Lumora Health was founded in 2017.

corpus.title: Lumora Health profile
corpus.text: Lumora Health was founded in 2017 by two nurses in Leeds and now sells triage software.

corpus.title: Startups to watch
corpus.text: Leeds-based Lumora Health was founded in 2017 and has raised two funding rounds.

claims.claim_text: Lumora Health was founded in 2017

cases.notes: One authoritative reference source is enough for a stable fact.

request.response_text: The Danube flows through Vienna.

corpus.title: Danube
corpus.text: The Danube is a river in Central and Southeastern Europe. The Danube flows through Vienna, Budapest and Belgrade before reaching the Black Sea.

claims.claim_text: The Danube flows through Vienna

cases.notes: A single blog is not enough.

request.response_text: Quillmetrics has 4,000 paying customers.

corpus.title: Quillmetrics rumours
corpus.text: Quillmetrics has 4,000 paying customers, according to a founder interview.

claims.claim_text: Quillmetrics has 4,000 paying customers

cases.notes: An authoritative source states something incompatible.

request.response_text: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Asia.

corpus.title: Mount Kilimanjaro
corpus.text: Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano in Tanzania. Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.

judgments.claim_text: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Asia
judgments.quote: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa
judgments.correction: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.

claims.claim_text: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Asia

cases.notes: Two academic sources disagree.
